name: compare_managed_members
description: Compare two authenticated inspect_managed_members Evidence records, supplied inline or by exact retained reference, using unique-only tiers: exact declared type, name, and CIL/signature; exact declared type, name, and signature (decoded or not); exact declared type, name, and decoded structural method shape; then exact CIL/signature or decoded structural method shape alone, which never takes a member whose own declared type and name remain unpaired on the other side or whose declaring type is unresolved. Signatures compare type operands by name, not by build-local metadata row. Names alone are never a matching basis; a member whose signature was not decoded, or whose same-named counterpart's was not, stays unknown rather than added or removed. Matched methods also compare aligned call-site shapes and observed target declaring-type/method names; missing or unaligned call edges and target names remain unknown. These static names do not prove overload identity or runtime dispatch. Metadata tokens remain build-local coordinates bound to each artifact SHA-256 and MVID, and the tuple digest does not itself remap them.
